info.title: SoraMetrics API
info.summary: Read-only analytics of the SORA v2 blockchain.
info.description:
Public, read-only, no authentication. Data is indexed from the SORA v2 chain (Substrate) and, for balances, holders, pools, staking and governance, read from a node at request time.

Prices are marginal on-chain quotes (`liquidityProxy.quote` of 0.000001 token to DAI, DAI = 1 USD). `illiquid: true` means selling 1 USD worth of the token returns under 0.50 USD: never derive a market cap or a holding value from that price.

A swap is worth its cheaper priced leg (a marginal quote can overvalue the illiquid side by orders of magnitude). Swap rows carry that value in both `in.usd` and `out.usd`; swap volume, trends, top pair and accumulation are sums of it.

Token supply shown by the site is the official SORA circulating figure, not on-chain total issuance.

Rate limits are per IP and per route (10–300 requests per minute); a 429 means wait for the next minute. Agents should prefer the MCP endpoint at `/mcp`, which wraps these routes as typed tools.
